interface.longDescription: BoardroomList is a job board for senior leaders: Manager, Director, Vice President, SVP, EVP, President and C-suite roles at America's 500 largest companies, taken from each company's own career site and re-checked every day. Ask for open roles by title, seniority, function, city or state, work mode and salary, and the app returns the title, level, location, posted pay range, date and a link to the role page on boardroomlist.com, where the company, the full description and the apply link are shown. Use it to scan the senior job market, track what is opening in a function or a city, or find roles that match a target level and pay. No sponsored listings, no recruiter feeds, no public profile.
capabilities: Filter by function, level, location and pay
defaultPrompt: What VP of Finance roles are open in Texas right now?
Show me remote director-level product jobs at Fortune 500 companies.
How many open C-suite roles are there and in which functions?
